reading.body:
This category lists eight platforms built around a similar function, an AI agent that answers, retrieves, or automates for employees or customers, but they split by audience: Decagon, Sierra, and Cognigy target customer facing service, while Aisera, Moveworks, and Glean target internal employee and IT support.

Kore.ai's entry stands out for scale specificity, citing 400 plus Fortune 2000 customers and naming its governance dashboard's actual components, audit logs, role based access control, and guardrails, a level of detail none of the other seven entries in this category provide about their own customer base or governance tooling.

Glean's permission aware retrieval across 100 plus connectors addresses a distinct risk from the conversational platforms: an enterprise search tool that can surface any document a user has access to needs to enforce the same access permissions the underlying systems already have, rather than exposing everything it can technically retrieve.

The data does not include pricing, adoption figures for the platforms other than Kore.ai's customer count, or comparative performance between these eight tools, so how enterprises are actually choosing among this many similar agent orchestration options is not established by this record.
